Located in Clarksville’s highly sought-after Westline community, 1406 W 9th Street #301 offers a rare standalone home in Austin’s newest blend of traditional charm and contemporary sophistication. With three bedrooms, two full bathrooms, a powder room, and two living spaces spread across two levels, this residence is designed for effortless living. The thoughtful layout ensures privacy for visiting family and guests, while the two-car garage and lock-and-leave lifestyle provide unmatched convenience. Perfectly positioned on the corner of the Westline community, the home strikes a harmonious balance between individuality and community. Crafted by the renowned Cumby Group, this home is part of an exclusive collection of 16 residences that seamlessly blend historical elements with modern design. Westline reimagines the architectural narrative of Clarksville while offering modern connectivity to downtown Austin. With its proximity to Lady Bird Lake, downtown Austin and world-class restaurants, this Westline home offers an exceptional opportunity to experience the best of both worlds in one of Austin’s most treasured neighborhoods. In the heart of Clarksville - a rare new construction thoughtfully designed to complement surrounding homes with the low maintenance of a new home. This modern zen cottage was Designed by Pollen Architecture with construction and curated interiors by Cary Paul Studios (2026 Best Builder via Austin Home Magazine).

At 3,090 sq ft and with 4-bedrooms and 3.5-bath over 3 levels, this residence blends architectural intention with boutique-level craftsmanship. Cypress cladding echoes the neighborhood in its 70s heyday. Accented with a standing-seam metal roof, and framed by Sierra Pacific windows, the exterior is classic yet warm and modern. The front porch is another neighborhood theme, re-interpreted with a cantilevered roof overhang.

Inside, natural light pours across open, airy living spaces anchored by a tiled floor to ceiling fireplace, the dramatic centerpiece of the living room. Every detail has been carefully considered, from custom cabinetry to boutique tile selections to hand-selected designer lighting, resulting in a home that feels elevated yet inviting. Cypress and white oak wood accent the interior in many spaces, with the wood slat wrapped staircase and kitchen wall as the main feature in the living and dining spaces.

With its blend of craftsmanship, warmth, and modern design, this is Clarksville living at its finest, a rare chance to own a new construction home in one of Austin’s most cherished historic neighborhoods.

forSale.description: Clarksville, one of the most sought-after neighborhoods in central Austin, where you can walk to everything. Incredibly special property with 5 distinct “units” that can be rented, this property also presents an ideal single-family residence featuring both attached and detached guest quarters-perfect for extended living, hosting, or added flexibility. Enjoy access to an array of culinary delights, with dozens of restaurants, bars, and retail, all just steps from your front and back door. The flagship Whole Foods stands nearby, making grocery shopping a cinch. Additionally, owners can enjoy the natural beauty of Lady Bird Lake's hike and bike trail, the YMCA, & Pease Park. Beyond its prime location, the property offers incredible residential income opportunity with a main house plus three, or possibly four, apartments with varying bedroom and bathroom mixes (see agent for unit breakdown). Each offers a charming blend of historic charm and modern convenience. Architecturally distinguished, the house and its counterparts on Baylor Street & West 9th Street date back to the early 1900s, having been carefully restored to preserve their original charm. The previous owner seamlessly combined a craftsman-style main house with Unit B, creating a living space that accommodates two to four bedrooms, an office, downstairs studio/living room, walk-in closet, laundry room, and two full bathrooms. The property is complete with two additional detached units and one private unit that could be rented or used as a guest apartment, plus an off-street parking area for three vehicles and a spacious two-car garage with storage and washer-dryer hookups. The custom decorative iron fence, crafted by welder/metalsmith Andy Reed a decade ago, adds a touch of elegance to the property. The current owner bought it for family to attend UT and cleaned it up immensely in their short time owning the property. It's clean, beautiful, and ready to be enjoyed! Call or text today for an easy showing!

Warm, modern living meets classic Clarksville charm in this beautifully reimagined urban retreat, just steps from Jeffrey's, Josephine House, and Café Medici. The original 1940 cottage was fully restored and expanded in 2023 with a sophisticated modern addition, creating a seamless 2,875 sq ft, 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath residence filled with curated details and refined craftsmanship. Inside, hand-selected finishes include marble handrails, full-slab backsplash, fluted cabinetry, boutique tile and wallpaper, and a striking wraparound skylight that floods the staircase tower with natural light. The lower-level kitchen is a showpiece with soapstone and marble counters, a Bertazzoni range, and paneled appliances. A spacious living and dining area opens directly to the private backyard and deck, creating effortless indoor-outdoor flow.The exterior features a metal and TPO roof, custom half-round gutters, Andersen windows, and a steel accordion door opening to thoughtfully designed landscaping with custom steel accents, irrigation, xeriscaping, and a composite deck. The original structure was taken to the studs and rebuilt with new electrical, plumbing, HVAC, spray-foam insulation, drywall, and a redesigned floor plan. Engineered oak flooring pairs with custom cabinetry and modern tile throughout. The comfortable primary suite features a spacious wet room with soaking tub and double shower, floating double vanity, and large walk-in closet. Laundry is available on both levels, with a stackable unit upstairs and full laundry room with sink below. Two additional bedrooms and a full secondary bath complete the bedroom level. At the main entry, the original portion offers a flexible bedroom, full bath, and bar with sink and beverage fridge, ideal as a guest suite, office, or private second living area. A private driveway and carport provide convenient alley access.

Located beneath a canopy of mature trees in the heart of historic Old West Austin/Clarksville, this beautifully restored/renovated residence blends timeless architecture with exceptional modern updates and an effortless indoor-outdoor lifestyle. Thoughtfully reimagined, the home preserves its historic character while enhancing comfort, functionality, and design for today's lifestyle. The heart of the home features a dramatic wall of glass that opens to a private backyard retreat with a sparkling pool, sauna, sprawling artificial turf lawn, spacious storage building, and an expansive patio ideal for entertaining. The flexible floor plan offers two bedrooms and a full bath on the main level, while upstairs features a spacious primary suite with a spa-inspired bath and peaceful treetop views. A second ensuite bedroom provides an ideal guest suite or additional primary, while a dedicated home office delivers the privacy professionals desire. Extensive improvements include all new windows and doors, premium kitchen appliances, updated baths, custom lighting, upgraded electrical, enhanced internet wiring, extensive drainage and site improvements, prof landscaping, and architectural landscape lighting. A covered carport and long driveway provide off-street parking for up to three vehicles, an uncommon luxury in this sought-after neighborhood. Just steps from the transformative 6th & Blanco development by MML Hospitality, residents enjoy luxury accommodations, destination dining, boutique retail, and a vibrant pedestrian-friendly atmosphere. With an outstanding Walk Score of 93, neighborhood cafes, acclaimed restaurants, parks, shopping, and downtown Austin are all within reach. Rich in history, thoughtfully restored, and ideally located, this exceptional property offers a rare opportunity to own a distinctive home in one of Austin's most cherished historic neighborhoods, where timeless character, modern luxury, and an unmatched Austin lifestyle come together.

The architecture blends classic peaked rooflines and chimney accents with modern windows and doors, complemented by rich stone detailing at the lower levels. Manicured lawns and white picket fences evoke the charm of the West Line Historic District, honoring its legacy of expansive estates while introducing a refined, contemporary lifestyle. Ideally located, Westline offers seamless access to Downtown Austin while preserving the neighborhood’s historic suburban character. Residence #802 (Floorplan G) features two en suite guest bedrooms and a spacious laundry room on the main level. The second level showcases an open-concept living space anchored by a gourmet kitchen with a center island, breakfast bar, and premium GE appliance package. Light, bright interior selections include White Patina European oak hardwood floors, Calacatta Gold marble countertops, and a white herringbone backsplash. The primary suite is complete with an expansive walk-in closet and dual vanity. Clarksville is a highly walkable neighborhood known for its historic bungalows, parks, and vibrant mix of cafés and shops. Located approximately one mile from Downtown Austin, Westline offers convenient access to West Austin Neighborhood Park, the Hike & Bike Trail, Lady Bird Lake, Whole Foods Market, Trader Joe’s, and major highways. Positioned atop a boutique residential building in an unparalleled location between Downtown, Old West Austin, and the vibrant dining and shopping destinations along North Lamar, Residence 302 offers sophisticated living moments from the best of Austin. As a top-floor residence, this 3-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom condo combines privacy, convenience, and elevated design in a truly exceptional setting.
The thoughtfully designed interiors center around an open-concept kitchen, living, and dining space ideal for both everyday living and entertaining, with large windows that showcase iconic views of the Texas State Capitol. The stunning modern kitchen is appointed with high-end Miele appliances, abundant cabinetry, and sleek finishes, seamlessly flowing into the light-filled living areas. Just beyond, a private terrace provides the perfect place to enjoy morning coffee or relaxing nights. 
The spacious primary suite serves as a serene retreat, featuring a generous walk-in closet, dual vanities, a large walk-in shower, and a luxurious soaking tub. Two additional bedrooms offer flexibility for guests or a home office. Residents enjoy access to a tranquil pool, secured access, valet trash service, two reserved parking spaces, and individual walk-in storage units, creating a lock-and-leave lifestyle in one of Austin’s most desirable urban locations.. Some homes give you more square footage. This one gives you more Austin.
Set in coveted Clarksville, 1406 W 13th Street offers a rare opportunity to own a charming single-story home in one of Austin’s most established close-in neighborhoods.
The thoughtfully laid-out interior retains much of its original character while updated bathrooms and a new roof add meaningful improvements. Natural light, original details, and an easy, livable floor plan make the home inviting from day one.
Outside, mature landscaping and bamboo create a private backdrop for the spacious backyard and cowboy pool, with plenty of room to imagine what’s next. A future owner might expand the existing footprint, create a larger primary suite, reimagine the detached garage as an office, studio, gym, or additional living space, or add a more substantial pool. Or simply move in, enjoy the home as it is, and make improvements over time.
And then there’s Clarksville. The appeal isn’t simply proximity to Austin, it’s the ability to make central Austin part of everyday life. Walk to neighborhood favorites, spend an afternoon at Pease Park, head downtown for dinner, or simply enjoy the character and community of one of Austin’s most beloved neighborhoods.
For the buyer who values location, character, and possibility over simply having more square footage, 1406 W 13th offers something increasingly difficult to find: a beautiful home to enjoy today, with room to create something even more personal tomorrow.
Less house. More Austin.

forSale.description: One of only 20 residences in the architecturally significant de Saligny, designed by Howard Barnstone and set in the heart of Old West Austin, this Clarksville condo offers a level of finish, privacy, and walkability that is genuinely difficult to find in Austin at any price. The end-unit position places it elevated on the hill, with sweeping views that take in the downtown skyline, a partial view of the Capitol, and brilliant morning sunrises. Below, the pool is shared exclusively among the building's 20 owners, and watching the still water from your own living room has a quiet, restorative quality that is hard to put into words. The unit has been taken to the studs and fully remodeled with new plumbing, new wiring, and thoughtful finishes throughout, all on a single, easy level. Herringbone hardwood floors run through the living area, where a gas log fireplace anchors the room. Hunter Douglas shades and custom Restoration Hardware panel drapes in both the living room and bedroom allow precise control of the light, and as an end unit, there is no shortage of it. The kitchen and bathroom feature custom marble countertops and Miele appliances, a standard of finish more common in a private home than a condominium. The gated patio extends your living space outdoors, offering room for a pet and a side gated run, a rare find in a lock-and-leave setting. Just beyond, a generous grassy area serves as a natural gathering spot where neighbors meet and dogs play. When you want more, walk to Josephine House, Jeffrey's, Cipollina, Caffe Medici, Fresh Plus, and the independent shops along West Lynn. Pease Park and Shoal Creek are minutes on foot. For a buyer seeking a pied-à-terre, second home, or a luxury Austin condo with no compromise on location or quality, this is a rare opportunity in 78703.

The Nokonah is Austin's original luxury high rise building. Corner unit with two sides of windows and a large wrap-around balcony with downtown views, wood floors, Granite kitchen counters w/ Stainless Steel appliances. One block to Whole Foods and across the street from the Shoal Creek Hike and Bike Trail. Amenities include 24hr concierge, fitness facilities, pool & Spa.

Situated at the gateway to one of Austin's most coveted neighborhoods, Encinal Condominiums is one of downtown Austin's earliest luxury condominium communities and remains an architectural landmark along the West Sixth Street corridor. The 22-residence development was thoughtfully designed to preserve the property's mature live oak grove, with homes intentionally arranged along a winding hillside to create a uniquely private community just blocks from downtown. Tucked away from the bustle of Clarksville, Unit 206 offers an exceptional opportunity to own a home in this sought-after and resurgent neighborhood.

Whether enjoying your morning coffee or watching the city lights come alive in the evening, the downtown skyline, visible from the top level, creates an unforgettable setting. An attached two-car garage, a true rarity this close to downtown, provides secure parking and valuable extra storage.

What truly sets this home apart is its position adjacent to the transformative Sixth & Blanco development. The approximately $150 million mixed-use destination, just steps from Encinal, is poised to become one of the city's most significant luxury developments. Upon completion, the project will feature curated restaurants and boutique retail, a luxury hotel, beautifully landscaped public gathering spaces, and an exclusive collection of residences, creating a vibrant, pedestrian-friendly destination unlike anything else in Austin.

For Encinal homeowners, this means more than exceptional dining and shopping just steps away, it represents an investment in a neighborhood experiencing thoughtful, world-class reinvestment.

Whether you're looking for a lock-and-leave primary residence, an in-town retreat, or a strategic investment in one of Austin's most exciting neighborhoods, this townhome offers a rare combination of location, views, convenience, and long-term potential.

Walk to some of Austin’s favorite destinations, including Whole Foods Market, BookPeople, Waterloo Records, Desnudo Coffee and Josephine House, while downtown, Lady Bird Lake, Pease Park, hike-and-bike trails and West Austin Neighborhood Park are all just minutes away. The kitchen offers playful pops of color, stainless steel appliances, ample storage, and an open connection to the living and dining areas, creating an easy, functional layout that lives larger than its footprint.

Built in 1965, yet fully updated, The Miriam retains its distinctive midcentury character with clean architectural lines, colorful accents, and an intimate community feel. As a ground-floor corner residence, Unit 104 offers the convenience of single-level living with no stairs and a desirable position within the complex.

The location is quintessential Clarksville, walk to Josephine House, Jeffrey’s, Fresh Plus, Taco Flats, and the shops and dining along West Lynn, with Downtown Austin, Lady Bird Lake, Pease Park, and the Hike-and-Bike Trail all nearby. One parking space and in-unit washer and dryer add everyday convenience. Stylish, low-maintenance, and incredibly well located, this is a rare opportunity to own a ground-floor corner residence in the heart of one of Austin’s most beloved neighborhoods.
